data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate opened 2023 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 500.0m. During 2023 there was an adverse reassessment of prior-year claims (reported as a net deficit of GBP 2.0m), and the directors note reserve deteriorations driven principally by increased provisions for potential exposures arising from the Ukraine War; prior-year weather catastrophes (Hurricane Ian and Winter Storm Elliot) also contributed to higher prior-year losses. While benign attritional experience in 2023 produced favourable outcomes in several classes, the overall prior-year movement is described as a small deterioration. No single quantified gross prior-year movement (insurance liabilities gross figure) was explicitly stated in the annual accounts notes, so an aggregate gross prior-year movement could not be calculated from the disclosed tables.
raw_causal_phrases: Within the calendar year technical result, a deficit of GBP 2.0 million (2022: surplus of GBP 30.8m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.

Reserve deteriorations on prior year losses contributed 0.7% (2022: 12.6% reserve release) to the net claims ratio driven by an increase in provisions held for potential exposures arising from the Ukraine War.
The prior year was significantly impacted by provisions for potential exposures arising from the Ukraine War and weather-related losses from Hurricane Ian and Winter Storm Elliot.

data.data_quality_notes: A clear gross aggregate prior-year reserve movement (gross insurance liabilities movement) is not explicitly provided in the notes. The report states net prior-year movement (deficit of GBP 2.0m) and discusses gross drivers qualitatively (Ukraine War, Hurricane Ian, Winter Storm Elliot). A gross prior-year movement could not be reliably calculated from the available stated tables without making material assumptions about reinsurer share movements. A gross claims development triangle is present (page 33) and has been partially extracted, but triangle parsing is incomplete and may not reconcile exactly to the reconciliation table. Prior-year development has therefore been left as null to avoid incorrect gross quantification.
